name: app- covariance
summary: Computes a noise covariance matrix from the first 60 seconds of a raw MEG FIF recording with MNE-Python compute_raw_covariance and saves it with an HTML report.
description: Reads the raw FIF file, crops it to 60 s, computes the covariance with mne.compute_raw_covariance and writes cov.fif and an MNE report. Use it for a noise covariance for source estimation, ideally on empty-room or baseline data. The registered branch master does not exist on GitHub; this description is based on the main branch.
